therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of myeloproliferative activity and normalization of hematological parameters
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Polycythemia Vera patients for whom standard treatment is difficult to apply
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Proportion of subjects who achieved durable phlebotomy-free complete hematological response at Month 12

results.effect_size: 8 out of 29 patients (27.6%) achieved phlebotomy-free CHR at months 9 and 12
results.target_engagement_evidence: JAK2 mutant allelic burden reduced by mean 19.17% from baseline at 52 weeks
biomarker_changes: Hematocrit decreased by mean 5.45% from baseline at 52 weeks
WBC count decreased by mean 11.71 x 10^9/L from baseline at 52 weeks
Platelet count decreased by mean 493.6 x 10^9/L from baseline at 52 weeks
JAK2 mutant allelic burden decreased by mean 19.17% from baseline at 52 weeks
subgroup_findings: Median time to first response was 11.90 months (95% CI: 5.50-12.00)
Mean duration of response maintenance was 3.77 months for longest response
safety_signals: All patients experienced thrombotic or hemorrhagic events (0 patients without events)
Some patients showed evidence of bone marrow fibrosis
results.dose_information: Starting dose 100 μg every 2 weeks (or 50 μg if on other cytoreductive therapy), gradually increased by 50 μg every 2 weeks up to maximum 500 μg every 2 weeks
